high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "annieharrt." The post features a group of nine women posing together on a balcony with a scenic view of a hilly landscape in the background. The setting appears to be a luxurious outdoor space, possibly part of a resort or event venue, as indicated by the elegant white metal railing and the vibrant purple flowers hanging above them. The women are dressed in various stylish outfits, ranging from formal dresses to more casual yet chic attire. The colors of their clothing include black, white, red, beige, and a leopard print dress.
